descriptionChirho: Piel: to deal with someone, act toward a person in a general sense, whether positively or negatively.
Piel: to cause pain or grief, to afflict or bring suffering upon someone.
Pual (passive): to be dealt with, to have something done to oneself by another.
Hitpael: to mock, make sport of, deal ruthlessly or abusively with someone, treating them with contempt.
Hitpael infinitive: to occupy oneself with an activity, to practice or commit actions, with a sense of deliberate engagement.
